title: Triggers
coreMove: Triggers make ideas easy to recall at useful moments; choose cues that are frequent, distinctive, and close to the behavior you want.

exampleSpecs.audience: retail marketers deciding where reminders belong
exampleSpecs.stakes: an exciting display may miss the breakfast moment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lucien chooses Cheerios-style frequency over vacation-style intensity

exampleSpecs.stakes: a funny song reference loses power if posted away from its natural cue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hanaa uses Rebecca Black's weekday cue

exampleSpecs.audience: brand managers pairing products with routines
exampleSpecs.stakes: a candy bar can vanish among snacks unless a strong routine calls it up
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Soren copies Kit Kat and coffee habitat design

exampleSpecs.audience: consumer goods analysts watching cultural cues
exampleSpecs.stakes: a public event can create recall the brand did not buy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Beatrice recognizes NASA Mars mission spillover

exampleSpecs.stakes: a broad cue may remind people of too many unrelated things
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Yara checks association strength and cue distance

exampleSpecs.audience: public health coordinators reducing missed visits
exampleSpecs.stakes: remembering a clinic at home may not help if transport decisions happen later
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Kofi places the cue near the action moment
